title: Heat Pumps, Solar, EVs, & Insulation: 25C and 25D Tax Credit Deadlines Explained
summary: 2025 webinar on the expiring federal 25C/25D credits and the state and utility rebates that remain, with stacked-incentive examples for Colorado, Massachusetts and California.

assertions.quote: That includes a $2,000 cap for heat pumps and heat pump water heaters

their roll out has been extremely slow
huge incentives from Massave up to $10,000 for heat pumps

verdicts.note: Possible where large state or utility rebates stack, but in most of the US incentives narrow rather than reverse the upfront gap.

if you were coming from electric resistance, if you're coming from propane

verdicts.note: Variable-speed heat pumps run longer at low output and even out temperatures, but single-stage units and poor installs do not.

assertions.quote: electrified homes uh can actually command a higher premium on the market

verdicts.note: Evidence of a sale-price premium is limited and mostly from industry or small studies.

assertions.quote: burning uh stuff indoors has on, you know, things like childhood asthma

verdicts.note: Unvented gas stoves measurably worsen indoor NO2 and are linked to asthma, but vented furnaces add little indoor pollution.
Electrification is listed as improving health outcomes by reducing lung irritants such as nitrogen dioxide and PM2.5; a stated co-benefit, not measured.
